channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: SBU sends text warning Russians are trying to recruit Ukrainians to register Starlink terminals
item.description: The messages come a week after Ukraine's defense ministry agreed with Starlink's parent company, SpaceX, to introduce mandatory registration for the internet terminals in Ukraine, a move meant to prevent their use by Russian forces.

item.title: Russian strike on Kharkiv Oblast killed 3 toddlers and their father, pregnant mother injured
item.description: A Russian strike on Bohodukhiv, Kharkiv Oblast, killed four people, including three toddlers, and injured two others, Governor Oleh Syniehubov reported overnight Feb. 11.

item.title: US military aid to Ukraine dropped 99% in 2025, report finds
item.description: European countries stepped in to fill the gap, increasing military aid to Ukraine by 67% and non-military support by 59% in 2025, according to the Kiel Institute for the World Economy.

item.title: Zelensky won't announce elections on war anniversary amid talks of US-driven timeline
item.description: Editor's Note: The article was updated following President Volodymyr Zelensky's comments.As of now, President Volodymyr Zelensky does not plan to announce presidential elections or a referendum on a possible peace deal with Russia on Feb. 24, a source in the President's Office familiar

item.title: Ukraine needs 'specific date' for entry into EU, Zelensky says
item.description: "I am absolutely confident that if ... there is no date, then Russia will do everything to block the process," President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Feb. 11.

item.title: Ukraine ready to hold new round of talks with Russia in US on Feb. 17-18. Moscow yet to confirm
item.description: According to the president, the negotiations would be hosted by the U.S. and will take place on Feb. 17 and Feb. 18. The talks, however, depend on Russia's agreement to take part, something that Ukraine and the U.S. have not yet received.

item.title: 'Remembrance is not a violation' — third Ukrainian athlete barred from wearing helmet at Olympics
item.description: Short track speed skater Oleh Handei said his helmet bore a line from Ukrainian poet Lina Kostenko: "Where there is heroism, there is no final defeat." It was banned from the Olympics on the grounds of being a "political slogan."

item.title: Ukraine reportedly strikes Tambov Oblast defense plant, military site in Volgograd Oblast
item.description: Ukrainian drones struck a Russian military plant in Michurinsk, Tambov Oblast, and a Defense Ministry site in Kotluban, Volgograd Oblast, overnight on Feb. 11-12, independent media and local authorities reported.

item.title: Russia targets Kyiv, Ukrainian cities with ballistic missiles as Moscow stalls on peace talks
item.description: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the ballistic missiles were targeting the city's infrastructure facilities.
